criteria.description: WeaponArmorItem gains an equipped: boolean field, defaulting to false for items that don't set it.
criteria.evidence: src/models/types/Inventory.ts (WP01, commit d62e54d on kitty/mission-equipment-stat-effects-01KY2MYD-lane-a) — WeaponArmorItem gains `equipped?: boolean`; optional field is absent/false by default, no migration needed.

criteria.description: WeaponArmorItem gains a structured, optional bonus shape (target stat + amount), distinct from statNote. Only maxHp/maxMana are valid targets.
criteria.evidence: src/models/types/Inventory.ts (WP01, d62e54d) — `statBonus?: { stat: 'maxHp' | 'maxMana'; amount: number }`, additive to damageBonus/armorRating/statNote, none of which are modified.

criteria.description: Effective max HP/Mana equal stored base plus the sum of every equipped item's bonus targeting that stat.
criteria.evidence: src/utils/__tests__/effectiveStats.spec.ts (WP01, d62e54d) — 'adds a single equipped bonus to the base value', 'stacks two equipped bonuses on the same stat instead of overwriting', 'sums only the equipped-with-matching-stat items in a mixed array'.
criteria.notes: npm run test:unit -- effectiveStats: 7/7 passed, re-run fresh during WP01 review.

criteria.description: Effective max HP/Mana (not raw stored base) renders on VitruveSheet.vue and ChildSheetTab.vue.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/VitruveSheet.vue and ChildSheetTab.vue (WP02, commit 52c47e9 on kitty/mission-equipment-stat-effects-01KY2MYD-lane-b) — both template interpolations swapped to effectiveMaxHp/effectiveMaxMana computeds calling computeEffectiveMaxStat; all four VitruveSheet.vue clamping computeds and both ChildSheetTab.vue clamping computeds + hasMana updated to use the effective value (grep for raw session.maxHp/maxMana in disabled-state logic returned zero hits during WP02 review).

criteria.description: A child/transformation character's effective max stats are computed from that child's own equipped items only — never the parent's inventory.
criteria.evidence: src/views/__tests__/PlayerView.spec.ts (WP02, 52c47e9) — 'never lets ChildSheetTab receive the parent equipment, or VitruveSheet receive the child equipment (SC-004 isolation)' (line 855), using strict non-membership assertions (`.some(...).toBe(false)`), not just length checks. Backed by src/controllers/__tests__/useInventoryStore.spec.ts's 'does not touch the existing inventory ref' and 'populates the cache with one entry per child, keyed by characterId'. Production code traced: PlayerView.vue's activeChildEquipment computed reads inventoryStore.childInventories.value[child.id], confirmed never inventoryStore.inventory.value.
criteria.notes: This was the mission's highest flagged risk (analyze finding A3); closed with a dedicated automated test, not manual QA only.

criteria.description: Unequipping an item (or an item with no bonus) excludes its contribution from the effective max on next computation — pure derived computation, no separate persistence/migration.
criteria.evidence: src/utils/__tests__/effectiveStats.spec.ts (WP01) — 'ignores an unequipped item even if it carries a statBonus', 'contributes 0 for an item with no statBonus at all'.

criteria.description: statNote is never read by the bonus-aggregation logic; renders as free text exactly as today.
criteria.evidence: src/utils/effectiveStats.ts (WP01, d62e54d) — grep for damageBonus/armorRating/statNote returned 3 hits, all in comments explaining the exclusion, zero in executable code (verified during WP01 review).
